author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
“It’s really dangerous, OK?” Tens of thousands of people are estimated to be held in solitary confinement on any given day in the United States.

This video, drawn from FRONTLINE’s 2014 documentary “Solitary Nation” goes inside Maine State Prison at a time when then-warden Rodney Bouffard was trying to reduce the use of solitary confinement.

“Crime and Punishment in America,” the new four-part series now streaming on PBS, also examines the practice.
title: The Reality of Solitary Confinement on Inmates
